result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks the export. I only compiled the `reports` module (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`, no errors). I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `exportJson` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The five fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The method now loops over the main, test, generated, build and deployment, and other aspects, in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose text files. It then reads that file and adds it to the zip.

With the default configuration the entries and their order are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. `git-history.zip` is written as before whenever `git-history.txt` exists.
